Root LICENSE SHA-256 e461a528b970e86ba79e11a3a5ac0bcc55774d53cd2970504e91c6005f3639e9

entries.name: chatly message_attachments storage RLS (pattern only)
scope: supabase/migrations/20260513045749_setup_rls_for_message_attachments_bucket.sql (insert/select/delete RLS on storage.objects scoped to bucket='message_attachments')
supabase/functions/create-msg-attachment/insert-attachment.ts (edge function pattern for recording attachment metadata after upload)
evidence: Local shallow clone: /tmp/tutoria-reuse-audit/chatly
Root LICENSE SHA-256 54db3fcc0a2a32d3f0c2de4a9e0211e347b165a5795ee02ccf56f9fe227175e1
Files inventoried and read but NOT copied wholesale.
required_actions: Preserve the upstream MIT notice in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Adapted SQL must use Tutoria's table name `public.message_attachments` (not chatly's column shape). Tutoria already has this table from migration 20260909000000_messaging_alpha_v2.sql with columns: id, message_id, storage_bucket, storage_path, filename, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at. The split_part(name,'/',1)::uuid cast in the RLS is incompatible with Tutoria's `<message_id>/<file>` storage layout; Tutoria's layout will be `<conversation_id>/<message_id>/<file>` and the RLS will be rewritten to enforce that.
The edge function pattern is a model only — Tutoria will attach the row to the message via a SECURITY DEFINER RPC `create_message_with_attachments`, not via a generic insert.
excluded_material: chatly's lemonsqueezy integration, paywall, AI-enhance-text function, expo push notifications, react-native mobile app.
Upstream brands, trademarks, marketplace copy, hard-coded marketing text, SaaS-ready template copy.

entries.name: Private-Chat-App-Supabase-NextJS RLS self-reference lessons (pattern only, study-only)
scope: fix-chat-rls.sql (the self-referencing RLS policy pattern that breaks reads; documents the FIX not the problem)
evidence: Local shallow clone: /tmp/tutoria-reuse-audit/Private-Chat-App-Supabase-NextJS
NO LICENSE file present in repository; status=STUDY_ONLY per Tutoria OSS policy.
required_actions: Do NOT copy or closely rewrite any source from this repository.

The self-referencing-RLS lesson reinforces Tutoria's existing pattern: RLS policies on `conversation_members` and `messages` MUST go through SECURITY DEFINER helper functions (public.is_conversation_member, public.conversation_summary) rather than directly referencing the same table. No code change is required from this reference; the existing Tutoria design already avoids the trap.
